cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.24)
project(sakura_editor_document_core LANGUAGES CXX)
set(CMAKE_CXX_CL_SHOWINCLUDES_PREFIX "メモ: インクルード ファイル:  ")
set(CMAKE_CL_SHOWINCLUDES_PREFIX "${CMAKE_CXX_CL_SHOWINCLUDES_PREFIX}")

# Generated by tools/build/sakura_build.py. Do not edit.
get_filename_component(SAKURA_REPO_ROOT "${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/../../../../../../../.." ABSOLUTE)
include("${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/../../../mingw-x64-debug.cmake")
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD 20)
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON)
set(CMAKE_CXX_EXTENSIONS OFF)
set(CMAKE_OBJECT_PATH_MAX 220)

add_library(sakura_editor_document_core STATIC
  "${SAKURA_REPO_ROOT}/sakura_core/workbench/editor/document/DocumentSession.cpp"
  "${SAKURA_REPO_ROOT}/sakura_core/include/sakura/editor/document/TextDocument.h"
  "${SAKURA_REPO_ROOT}/sakura_core/include/sakura/editor/document/UndoHistory.h"
  "${SAKURA_REPO_ROOT}/sakura_core/include/sakura/editor/document/LayoutProjection.h"
  "${SAKURA_REPO_ROOT}/sakura_core/include/sakura/editor/document/DocumentPersistence.h"
  "${SAKURA_REPO_ROOT}/sakura_core/include/sakura/editor/document/DocumentSession.h"
)
target_include_directories(sakura_editor_document_core PUBLIC "${SAKURA_REPO_ROOT}/sakura_core/include")
target_compile_features(sakura_editor_document_core PRIVATE cxx_std_20)
target_compile_options(sakura_editor_document_core PRIVATE -fpack-struct=8 -include "${SAKURA_REPO_ROOT}/src/main/modules/generated/abi/mingw-x64-debug/sakura_editor_document_core.h")
target_compile_definitions(sakura_editor_document_core PRIVATE _WIN32_WINNT=0x0A00 NOMINMAX UNICODE _UNICODE)
